analysis_population.inclusion: reasoning models; n_valid > 0; full-context labels parsed

split_contract.assignment: frozen deterministic prompt_fold from the audited split registry
split_contract.leakage_check: every instance_id maps to exactly one prompt_fold

shared_estimator.penalty: L2=1.0 on standardized slopes; intercept unpenalized
shared_estimator.preprocessing: training-fold mean imputation and z-standardization; test fold transformed with training values
shared_estimator.probability_metric: out-of-fold log score; differences reported in bits per trace
shared_estimator.continuous_metric: out-of-fold R2; paired gain equals per-trace squared-error reduction divided by outcome variance

training_fold_preprocessing.missing_values: replace x_ij by the training-fold mean before standardizing
training_fold_preprocessing.held_out_contract: the held-out fold never contributes to imputation means, scales, or coefficients; fixed prompt-stratum dummy columns are created from prompt metadata before CV and use no outcomes

categorical_regression.reference_class: eta_i0 = 0; eta_ic = alpha_c + z_i^T beta_c for c=1,...,K-1

continuous_regression.objective: minimize sum_i (y_i - alpha - z_i^T beta)^2 + lambda ||beta||_2^2
continuous_regression.closed_form: theta_hat = (X^T X + lambda P)^+ X^T y, with P_00=0 and P_jj=1 for slopes

behavior_features.amount: a_ib = positive valid segments for behavior b / all valid segments in trace i
behavior_features.phase_prevalence: r_ibp = positive valid segments for b in phase p / valid segments in phase p
behavior_features.conditional_share: s_ibp = r_ibp / sum_q r_ibq when the sum is positive; otherwise all shares are zero
behavior_features.timing_contrasts: t_ib,1 = s_ib,middle - s_ib,early; t_ib,2 = s_ib,late - s_ib,early
behavior_features.descriptive_timing_centroid: c_ib = 0.5 s_ib,middle + s_ib,late, defined only when behavior b occurs

categorical_predictive_gain.reported_increment: Delta(B|A) = mean_i g_i(B|A), in bits per held-out trace
categorical_predictive_gain.probability_multiplier: 2^Delta is the geometric-mean multiplier in held-out probability assigned to the true class

exact_grouped_shapley.players: the four behaviors in one signature family; an amount player is one rate and a timing player is its two timing contrasts
exact_grouped_shapley.coalitions: all 2^4 = 16 subsets, fit on the same outer folds
exact_grouped_shapley.equation: phi_ib = sum_{S subseteq B\{b}} |S|!(m-|S|-1)!/m! * [v_i(S union {b}) - v_i(S)]
exact_grouped_shapley.domain_summary: mean phi_ib over held-out traces whose true domain is d
exact_grouped_shapley.efficiency: sum_b phi_ib = v_i(B) - v_i(empty set), up to numerical precision

direction_overlay.timing: mean_domain(c_b) - mean_other_domains(c_b), conditional on behavior occurrence
direction_overlay.interpretation: direction is descriptive and separate from Shapley predictive credit

prior_staged_outcome_ladder_RQ3.primary_metrics: AUROC for binary outcomes; R2 for continuous outcomes
prior_staged_outcome_ladder_RQ3.claim_boundary: associational prediction, not a within-model causal effect

omnibus_domain_signature_RQ8.amount_step: four behavior rates from one signature family
omnibus_domain_signature_RQ8.timing_step: two conditional phase contrasts per behavior

binary_quality_signature_RQ9.unit: completed, scored trace within fixed model and domain
binary_quality_signature_RQ9.role: common-scale sensitivity analysis; native-outcome analysis is primary for localization

pairwise_domain_localization_RQ8a.target: binary domain identity for all 28 unordered pairs
pairwise_domain_localization_RQ8a.correction_family: Benjamini-Hochberg across all 336 pair × model × family tests, separately for amount and timing

domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.method: exact grouped Shapley decomposition of out-of-fold log-score gain
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.groups: the four behaviors in each family
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.timing_base: length plus all four behavior rates
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.localization: per true domain within each fixed model
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.direction: one-domain-versus-rest standardized amount contrast; conditional timing-centroid contrast
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.correction_family: Benjamini-Hochberg across all model × domain × behavior attributions, separately for amount and timing
domain_behavior_attribution_RQ8b.claim_boundary: predictive credit is shared under correlation; it is not causal attribution

native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.unit: completed, scored trace within fixed model and domain
native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.targets: native binary outcomes retained as binary; moral, idea, and safety scores retained as continuous
native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.minimum_support: n >= 40; binary cells also require >=20 per class; continuous cells require >=3 unique outcomes
feature_steps: two timing contrasts per behavior beyond amount
native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.attribution: exact four-group Shapley decomposition for every estimable cell
native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.correction_family: Benjamini-Hochberg across all estimable model × domain × family blocks; behavior attributions corrected separately by layer
native_outcome_signature_RQ9a.claim_boundary: predictive association only; the data cannot show that inducing a signature improves an answer

uncertainty_and_testing.bootstrap: 1,000 paired prompt resamples; class-stratified for categorical targets and outcome-quantile-stratified for continuous targets
uncertainty_and_testing.test: one-sided paired sign-flip test of held-out per-trace score improvement
uncertainty_and_testing.support_rule: 95% interval lower bound > 0 and BH q < 0.05
uncertainty_and_testing.multiplicity: amount and timing are separate predeclared testing families

result_counts.interpretation: Domain signatures are widespread and localized by domain pair and behavior; native-outcome associations remain cell-specific and non-causal.
